note: Template. No source is rights-confirmed, no narration is written, no label exists. Keep the filled copy on the test machine only, never in the repo.

sources.role: voiced documentary/news (en) — speech close to picture, names and numbers
low-speech footage or product/vlog (zh/vi) — speech does NOT describe the picture

REAL-HOLDOUT.sources_overlap_with_dev: FORBIDDEN (split by video, not by sentence)

readiness_states.READY_FOR_PAID_SCRIPT_DRAFT: Inputs for the paid narration-draft step exist and are cleared: rights, sha256, third-party processing, local-ASR cues. Narration and human labels are NOT needed yet. Still needs a separate Owner cost approval.
readiness_states.READY_FOR_EVALUATION: Narration/cues locked, human labels valid and locked, scoring rules (and for HOLDOUT, parameters) locked to a commit. Only then may a split be measured.
readiness_states.rule: Check with tools/validate_manifest.py --stage draft|eval --split REAL-DEV|REAL-HOLDOUT. Never fill fields with made-up or synthetic data to pass a check.

field_notes.asr_status: 'ok' when local ASR completed (even with no speech found); 'failed' when it did not. Only 'ok' counts.
field_notes.cue_count: Number of cues local ASR produced. 0 is valid for a no-speech source; then speech_ratio must be 0 and the empty cue file is still hashed in cues_sha256.
field_notes.speech_ratio: Computed from the cue file: union of accepted cue intervals / duration_ms, NOT rounded (README §3.3). Never typed; --verify-files recomputes it. 0 means no speech detected by that ASR run, not proof of silence.
field_notes.cues_path: Cue file written by tests/mastering/x2/asr_cues.py (JSON {asr_model, params, versions, asr_status, cues:[{start_ms,end_ms,text}], rejected:[...]}) relative to the --verify-files directory; kept on the test machine, not in the repo.
field_notes.cue_rejected_count: Cues the ASR emitted that are impossible for the file (end <= start, start < 0, end after duration_ms). Kept in the cue file's 'rejected' list with a reason, never deleted, not counted in cue_count or speech_ratio.
field_notes.path: Media file relative to the --verify-files directory. --verify-files recomputes its sha256.
